title: Introduction to Efficient Deep Learning
desc: Overview of deep learning efficiency challenges, latency, memory, energy constraints, and the roadmap to efficient models.

title: Pruning and Sparsity
desc: Removing redundant weights to reduce memory footprint and compute. Unstructured vs structured pruning, lottery ticket hypothesis.

title: Quantization
desc: Reducing precision of weights and activations. INT8 quantization, Quantization-Aware Training (QAT), Post-Training Quantization (PTQ).

title: Neural Architecture Search (NAS)
desc: Automating the design of neural networks to optimize for both accuracy and efficiency under hardware constraints.

title: Knowledge Distillation
desc: Transferring knowledge from a large teacher model to a smaller, more efficient student model.

title: Hardware for Deep Learning
desc: Basics of AI accelerators, systolic arrays, GPUs, and how algorithm-hardware co-design enables efficiency.
